technical.fixed_ratio_rule: Place on a fixed 1672x941 game canvas and scale uniformly with min(viewportW/1672, viewportH/941); do not resize individual elements independently in response to viewport dimensions.
technical.suggested_world_placement: Use v01/world/WORLD_MAP_PLACEMENT_PROPOSED.json site home bottom anchor (264,700), not LOCKED.
technical.asset_modularity: Each building tier and each furniture item is a separate PNG; swap asset path via manifest while keeping the anchor and layout system stable.

known_limitations: Preview art, not yet approved as FINAL/LOCKED
Relative render scale and click targets need phone-landscape QA
No other hideout tiers' interiors generated in this phase
No sprite animations or hand-exported character motion frames included
